note: white_unity is the per-column mean of the 128-line white strip that SilverFast
read at t=6.9249 with the unity table loaded and DVDSET armed, so the ASIC had
already removed the dark term. coeff is the same column of SilverFast's second
shading upload at t=7.758. Both are de-padded: the blob is written in 512-byte
blocks of 126 (dark, gain) pairs plus two gain=0 pad pairs.
coeff = round(sf_target[channel] * 0x2000 / white_unity) to within ~10 LSB.
sf_target[0] is 0xFFFF exactly; SilverFast tilts G/B up 1-2% as its own white
balance, which NegPy does later in the pipeline instead.
